scripts.verify: pnpm check:eol && turbo run typecheck && turbo run lint && turbo run test --concurrency=1 && pnpm policy:test && pnpm tasks:check
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev:psql: docker exec -it yourtal-postgres psql -U yourtal -d yourtal
scripts.dev:fresh: pnpm dev:reset && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm media:publish
scripts.//verify: The repo gate. It runs the line-ending guard, typecheck (incl. `go vet`), lint, every test suite, the Cerbos policy suite and the task-board staleness check. Each clause was added because it was OUTSIDE the gate and something broke there unseen: Go had no package.json so `turbo run test` ran 0 of 23 Go test files; lint was red in @yourtal/db while verify passed; the 384 policy tests ran only by hand. --concurrency=1 is required — @yourtal/db, @yourtal/api and both Go services share one Postgres. check:eol is first because it is the cheapest and because a CRLF shell script fails on the Linux host rather than here.
